mapper.update: LOCK TABLE finder_rollout IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.select: WITH ins AS ( INSERT INTO finder_rollout (config_hash, baseline) VALUES (#{configHash}, #{baseline}) ON CONFLICT (config_hash) DO NOTHING RETURNING 1) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
mapper.update: UPDATE finder_rollout SET enqueued_at = now() WHERE config_hash = #{configHash} AND enqueued_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT config_hash AS configHash, started, enqueued_at AS enqueuedAt, baseline FROM finder_rollout ORDER BY started DESC, config_hash LIMIT #{limit}
